V. 14.
It was the preparation of the p•ſſo••r—For this Reaſon both the Jews and Pilate were deſirous to bring the Matter to a Concluſion. Every Friday was called the Preparation (namely, for the Sabbath.) And as often as the Paſſover fell on a Friday, that Day was called, the Preparation of the Paſſover.
